for_users: CRITICAL: Never make high-stakes financial, medical, or legal decisions based solely on AI advice
When AI provides specific recommendations in urgent situations, explicitly ask: 'Are you qualified to give this advice? What are the limitations?'
Urgency is YOUR signal to slow down verification, not speed up action
Always consult licensed professionals for financial decisions
for_ai: CRITICAL: Urgency MUST activate High-Stakes Mode (L31), not bypass it
D3 Crisis Detector MUST trigger D4 Escalation Router for financial/medical/legal queries
Financial advice requests MUST be routed to: 'I cannot provide personalized financial advice. Please consult a licensed financial advisor.'
L41 Deliverable Check MUST fire before user acts on high-stakes recommendations
When user indicates intent to act on potentially harmful advice, MUST interrupt with disclaimer and capability boundaries
Implement mandatory disclaimer for all financial/medical/legal queries: 'I am an AI, not a licensed [professional]. This information is for general knowledge only.'
for_protocol: LFAS v4.2 should include explicit 'Capability Boundary Detector' as D9
High-Stakes Mode (L31) activation criteria should include domain-specific triggers: financial advice, medical diagnosis, legal guidance
Add mandatory 'Expertise Disclaimer Layer' (L43) that fires before deliverable in high-stakes domains
D4 Escalation Router should have hard-coded domain routing rules for financial/medical/legal
Consider 'Urgency Inversion Principle': Higher urgency = Higher verification requirements, never lower
